profile_text.body:
Blender Foundation is a nonprofit, open-source organization that develops and maintains Blender, a free 3D creation suite covering modeling, rigging, animation, rendering, visual effects, camera and object tracking, and 2D drawing within a 3D viewport. The software features a Python-controlled interface and a Python API that supports community-developed add-ons. Blender is a member of ASWF, Khronos, the Linux Foundation, and OIN, and the foundation describes support from hardware vendors including AMD, Apple, Intel, NVIDIA, and Qualcomm.

On the AI side, the site tracks Blender AI Add-ons, described as third-party plugins for 3D creation that run locally and are open-source, with model provenance varying by plugin. Recent development work noted on the site includes a Cycles Texture Cache feature coming in Blender 5.2 LTS intended to reduce memory use when rendering scenes with many image textures, and a "Winter of Quality 2026" initiative in which the development team focused on stability and overall quality during the 2025 to 2026 northern winter period.

No litigation, MCP server registrations, or SEC filings are associated with the foundation in the held facts.
